presentationColumns.name: Snapshot Week Start Date
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Snapshot Week Start Date

presentationColumns.name: On Hand Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.On Hand Units
presentationColumns.description: Physical stock on hand at store-SKU-week grain. Use this for operational inventory reporting; when looking at exception severity, prefer latest or current risk measures instead of averaging across many weeks.

presentationColumns.name: Available Units
presentationColumns.description: Inventory available for sale after reservations and unavailable stock. Use this to understand sellable inventory; pair it with stockout counts or current risk scores for availability analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Reserved Units
presentationColumns.description: Units reserved and not immediately available for sale.

presentationColumns.name: Stockout Count
presentationColumns.description: Count of weekly store-SKU snapshots flagged as stockout. This is an operational stockout count, not an AI alert count; AI alert cases apply stricter demand and risk criteria.

presentationColumns.name: Inventory Value At Cost
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Inventory Value At Cost
presentationColumns.description: Inventory value calculated using standard product cost.

presentationColumns.name: Average Weeks Of Supply
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Average Weeks Of Supply
presentationColumns.description: Average estimated weeks of supply based on stock and demand.

presentationColumns.name: Average Store-SKU Overstock Risk Index
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Average Store-SKU Overstock Risk Index
presentationColumns.description: Historical average raw overstock risk index at store-SKU-week grain; not scaled to 0-100.

presentationColumns.name: Average Store-SKU Stockout Risk Index
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Average Store-SKU Stockout Risk Index
presentationColumns.description: Historical average raw stockout risk index at store-SKU-week grain; not scaled to 0-100.

presentationColumns.name: Current Store-SKU Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Current Store-SKU Stockout Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Latest-week store-SKU stockout risk rescaled to a 0-100 dashboard score. Use this for current inventory risk because it avoids diluting the latest state with older weeks.

presentationColumns.name: Current Store-SKU Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Current Store-SKU Overstock Risk Score
presentationColumns.description: Latest-week store-SKU overstock risk rescaled to a 0-100 dashboard score. Use this for current overstock monitoring because it reflects the latest available inventory snapshot.

presentationColumns.name: Available Unit Share
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory KPIs.Available Unit Share
presentationColumns.description: Available units as a percentage of on-hand units.

presentationColumns.name: Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.description: Internal data-generation scenario marker; hidden from business-facing analysis.
